premises.text: The medical tourism industry is dominated by unvetted doctors and poor outcomes due to a lack of expertise.
premises.evidence_span: this lack of expertise, which for patients means unvetted doctors and poor outcomes, leads to a lack of trust.

premises.text: A significant amount of money is spent on medical tourism, indicating a demand for international healthcare.
premises.evidence_span: $10 billion was spent last year by medical travelers from the United States.

premises.text: The global medical tourism market is growing rapidly, fueled by a swelling global middle class.
premises.evidence_span: Globally, over $400 billion was spent last year all around the world by medical travelers. And this number is growing at 25% a year.

premises.text: Patients travel for medical care to save money, save time, and gain access to procedures not available in their home market.
premises.evidence_span: the three main reasons patients travel for medical care. The first is to save money. The second is to save time. The third is to gain access.

premises.text: MedRepublic connects patients with vetted, top-rated doctors around the world.
premises.evidence_span: MedRepublic is an online global health marketplace that enables American and Canadian patients to connect with English-speaking, board-certified, top-rated doctors around the world.

premises.text: A strict vetting process ensures only qualified doctors are accepted into the MedRepublic platform.

premises.text: MedRepublic facilitates communication and administrative tasks between patients and doctors.
premises.evidence_span: MedRepublic does all the administrative work collecting documents, records, and payments so doctors can do what they do best.

premises.text: Patients can save significant amounts of money by using MedRepublic for medical procedures.

value.text: Patients gain access to affordable, timely, and vetted medical care through MedRepublic.
